top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A merry go cycle was observed without loose fill beneath.    Note: A picture was taken.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation emergency plan is missing a designated location where all caregivers and children will meet.
